steps.body: Small adds are fast. **+1** is the next number. **+2** is two hops. **+3** is three hops.
steps.narration: Small adds are fast. Plus one is the next number. Plus two is two hops. Plus three is three hops.

widget.prompt: Start at 9. Hop forward 1. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That hopped backward. +1 goes forward, to the next number: 10.
The line stops at 10 — and 9 + 1 is exactly 10, the next number.

widget.missFeedback: +1 means the very next number after 9.

predict.prompt: Starting at 9 and hopping forward 1 — where will you land?
predict.reveal: One hop from 9 lands exactly on 10 — nine and one more make a full ten. One forward hop always lands on the very next counting number.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents count on small.
invariants: The manipulated model and the mathematical relationship for count on small must stay consistent.
misconceptions: Changing a visible feature without preserving the relationship that defines count on small.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: What change would make the model stop representing the same mathematical relationship?

explanationVariants: Start at 6, hop 2: say 7, 8. You land on 8.
6 and 2 more is 8 — two quick hops.

commonErrors.feedback: That's only 1 more. Hop twice: 7, then 8.

hints: The second hop is your answer.

steps.body: Adding **0** changes nothing. 5 + 0 is still 5. Zero hops means you stay right where you are.
steps.narration: Adding zero changes nothing. Five plus zero is still five. Zero hops means you stay where you are.

steps.body: See it fast — don't count one by one!

widget.prompt: Flash the dots, then pick how many you saw.

commonPicks.feedback: One more than that — a full row of 5 plus 2 in the next row is 7.
One fewer — count the rows: 5 on top, 2 below, makes 7.

widget.missFeedback: A full top row is 5. Then count the dots below it.
widget.successFeedback: Seven — 5 and 2 more, seen at a glance!

explanationVariants: Start at 7, hop 3: say 8, 9, 10. You land on 10.
hints: The third hop is your answer.

explanationVariants: Adding 0 means no hops at all — 5 stays 5.
Zero more than 5 is just 5. Nothing was added.

commonErrors.feedback: Adding 0 doesn't erase the 5 — it means you add nothing, so 5 stays 5.
That's 5 + 1. Here you add 0 — no hops — so the answer is still 5.

widget.fallbackFeedback: 0 more than 5 is 5. Adding zero changes nothing.

explanationVariants: Start at 8, hop 2: 9, 10. You land right on 10.
8 and 2 more is 10 — a full ten.

widget.prompt: Mia has 8 counters and gets 2 more. Enter her new total without counting from 1.

takeaways: Adding 0 keeps the number the same.
Some small adds land right on 10.
steps.teaser: next: when the second number is big, flip it around.

concept.body: Slow it down. **+1** is always the next number. After 4 comes 5, so 4 + 1 = 5.
concept.narration: Plus one is always the next number. After four comes five, so four plus one is five.

explanationVariants: One hop from 4 lands on 5 — the next number.

widget.prompt: Start at 4. Hop forward 1. Tap where you land.

commonLandings.feedback: That's 2 hops. +1 is just one hop: 5.
